login.intro: For the artist only. Customers don't need an account.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email address. You'll receive a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} is the administrator address, you'll receive an email with a link within a few minutes. The link is valid for 1 hour.
forgot.unavailable: Emails can't be sent right now (SMTP is not configured). Change ADMIN_PASSWORD in the .env file and run the seed again (see README).

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password. You'll then be logged out everywhere.
reset.success: Your password has been changed. You can now log in.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again or request a new one.
